title: GHA Indie Worker v1 lease protocol
$comment: HUMAN-AUTHORED PEER AUTHORITY of contracts/typespec/lease.tsp. Neither is generated from the other. WorkerLease here is the same type as the published schema/v1/workerlease.json, and scripts/parity.mjs checks the two still agree -- the published v1 document keeps its $id and its shape and gains a second authority instead of being replaced by one. `id` and `revision` are deliberately unbounded above, exactly as v1 has them; adding a maximum here would tighten a contract consumers are already coded against.

LeaseErrorCode.description: Why a lease was refused. `InterfaceError` in src/error.rs; the crate parses and validates, so these are the only three ways parsing fails.

WorkerLease.description: A worker's claim on a unit of work. `protocol::WorkerLease`; published as schema/v1/workerlease.json.

id.description: Lease identity. Non-empty; deliberately unbounded above, as the published v1 schema has it.

revision.description: Schema revision the payload conforms to, e.g. `gha-indie-worker-0001`. A consumer that does not know the revision refuses the lease rather than guessing.

payload.description: Lease body, shaped by `revision`. Free-form here on purpose: this envelope is versioned by `revision`, and typing the payload in the envelope would make every payload change an envelope change.

ok.description: False only when the service is up enough to answer and still unable to serve.

protocol.description: Wire protocol version as a string. `protocol::PROTOCOL_VERSION`.
